# Else Kjær Mikkelsen

Else Kjær Mikkelsen is a specialty responsible nurse representing Region Midtjylland (Central Denmark Region) on the steering committee of the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) [^src1]. Her position on the committee underscores the central role that nursing professionals play in the strategic governance, coordination, and quality assurance of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treatment pathways in Denmark [^src1]. 

The steering committee serves as the strategic governing unit for DANIBD, driving a broader national effort to systematize and improve IBD care through cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, and evidence-based treatment guidelines [^src1]. Mikkelsen's membership is documented in the 2023 annual report, which outlines the committee's composition and evaluates detailed quality data from the period of October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023 [^src1].
